title: (2nd LD) Seoul shares rise for 2nd day on tech rally amid rate hike woes
caption:
Seoul shares rallied over two percent as foreign investors snapped up semiconductor and defense shares, ignoring overnight declines on Wall Street and hot US inflation data. Heavy gains in chipmakers like SK hynix offset broader macroeconomic worries.
